scope: Only the uniquely anomalous contract and its organization Stripe reference are queried. No names, IDs, emails or secrets are saved. No mutations.

stripe.reason: No Stripe subscription or customer reference in the contract or company. No Stripe-wide lookup attempted.

repairPlan: No automatic repair is justified. Qualify the original contract privately with the owner, obtain its real dates/status or establish QA/historical provenance. Preserve read access and do not invent an expiry.
